claims_and_limits: All three es60fst02 solution sets were independently checked as feasible and each has cardinality 88.
Equal best objective does not establish global optimality; QOBLIB records N/A for the quantum submissions' optimality bounds.
Published runtime numbers are reported under QOBLIB's native conventions, but differing algorithms and hardware mean these submissions are not a randomized same-platform head-to-head trial.

For Symthaea research, rerun all methods on matched graph instances and disclose hardware/resource boundaries; track QOBLIB-native runtime separately from all-in latency/cost that includes queueing or compilation.

The JavaScript feasibility checker was executed during this authoring session but is not committed as a standalone script. The Rust parser/verifier/CLI extension in PR #8324 is intended to make this check independently repeatable in the repository.
No QPU was run by this audit; no new best-known solution or quantum advantage is claimed.
